d:
A soulful, heart-wrenching ballad that captures the beauty of falling in love and the quiet sorrow of being torn apart by life’s cruel timing.
Singer : Zeeshan Ali
Featuring artists : Yuvraj Tung & Seerat Mast
Lyricist : Sandeep Aulakh
Music composition : Sandeep Aulakh & Honey Dhillon
Music : Honey Dhillon
Director : Gurpal Singh
Colour grade : Onkar Singh
